evidence.AC1: POST /todos with {"title":"past","dueDate":"2026-11-01"} returned 201 with dueDate "2026-11-01". POST without dueDate returned 201 with dueDate null. The date has no time part.
evidence.AC2: PATCH /todos/4 with {"dueDate":"2026-11-05"} returned 200 and set the date. PATCH with {"dueDate":null} returned 200 and dueDate became null. PATCH changed todo 2's date from 2026-12-01 to 2026-11-02.

evidence.AC4: Today (UTC) is 2026-11-13. GET /todos?overdue=true returned only the two todos with past due dates that were not done (2026-11-01 and 2026-11-02).
